# WaterPoint

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("WaterPoint")`

One of the points that a `River` runs through or that the outline of a `Lake` passes through, in order. The water follows a smooth curve that passes through every point without looping.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Depth` | `number` | `0` | read/write | The depth of a river at this point, in meters. At 0, the water's `Size.Y` is used. |
| `Position` | `vector` | `vector.create(0, 0, 0)` | read/write | The position the water passes through. For a `River`, its height is the height of the surface there, so a river whose points descend flows downhill. A `Lake` and a `Spline` are level at the water's `SurfaceLevel` and use only the horizontal position. |
| `Sharp` | `boolean` | `false` | read/write | Whether the curve has a corner at this point instead of being rounded. |
| `Width` | `number` | `0` | read/write | The width of a river at this point, in meters. It changes smoothly toward the next point's width. At 0, the water's `Size.X` is used. |
